Independently confirmed by qnfo-fleet-control/version-compare.mjs (sha 86835e1a, 5,840 B), which records qnfo-fleet-control/worker.js (75,875 B, sha d9d438f0) as: module 1 var VERSION='0.3.3' var WORKER='qnfo-fleet-advisor'; module 2 var VERSION='1.0.0' var WORKER='qnfo-fleet-calibrator'.
rev6_reversal_of_rev4.consequence: qnfo-fleet-advisor's 2026-09-13T14:21:14Z write was emitted BY qnfo-fleet-control running its advisor module. It is not a separate live worker. The same pattern covers qnfo-pipeline-ops and qnfo-register-guard, both of which my own merge map had already assigned to fleet-exec.

corrected_liveness_rule.rule: Write-evidence is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT for worker identity. A name is a live WORKER iff it appears in the Cloudflare scripts list. A name appearing in D1 writes but NOT in the CF scripts list is a retired MODULE executing inside a hub under its own WORKER constant.
corrected_liveness_rule.short_form: CF scripts list decides EXISTENCE; D1 writes decide ACTIVITY.
corrected_liveness_rule.supersedes: rev4's rule ('liveness must be measured from D1 writes') is incomplete and withdrawn.

comparator_fix_exists_but_undeployed.status: 20/20 assertions pass per version-compare.test.mjs; NOT deployed
comparator_fix_exists_but_undeployed.bug_it_fixes: A leading 'v' makes parseInt('v1') NaN -> 0, so 'v1.1.0' parses as [0,1,0] and ranks LOWER than '1.0.0' = [1,0,0]. personal-companion is therefore labelled canonical-ahead and redeployed hourly, forever, all attempts failing.
comparator_fix_exists_but_undeployed.load_bearing_rule_5: Same numeric core with a DIFFERENT suffix is UNORDERABLE and the caller must NOT redeploy. Without it a naive semver rule would order '3.6.1' above '3.6.1-subscribers' and DOWNGRADE qnfo-gateway, and '1.14.1' above '1.14.1-gtd-guard' and strip the cloud-ops guard.
comparator_fix_exists_but_undeployed.live_state: today's scan still reports drifted=9 ahead=9; personal-companion still loops. The blocker is the deploy gap, not the analysis.

auto_close_predicate_defect.mechanism: qnfo-backlog-exec's health-availability branch closes a ticket when the TARGET re-probes PASS. For a ticket whose subject is 'the monitor reports X incorrectly', the re-probe passes precisely BECAUSE the monitor is wrong. #693 was closed 7.2 minutes after filing on this path.
auto_close_predicate_defect.reclose_warning: #693 will be auto-closed again whenever the drain selects it, because its title still matches isHealthAvailability and workerTarget still resolves qnfo-ai, whose binding probe passes. Recorded on the ticket so a future 'closed' is not misread as a fix.
